title: Tether provided secured credit to Rumble Freedom First Holding Limited
summary: Tether and the Rumble Irish holding company entered a five-year secured facility with commitments of €317,533,400.90, collateral and covenant rights, and a conversion mechanism subject to a 9.9% voting-power limitation.

provenance.method: free-range five-role primary-source review and bounded graph synthesis

qualifiers.security: Northern Data shares, holding-company equity interests, guarantees, and borrower-group assets subject to agreed principles
qualifiers.conversion_right: One-time first-anniversary conversion right; pre-funded warrant used above 9.9% voting power
qualifiers.boundary: Creditor and conversion rights are documented; operational control is not established by this relation alone.
